title: Largest fifth pivot under Gaussian elimination with complete pivoting
statement: The largest fifth pivot growth factor under Gaussian elimination with complete pivoting is the unique real root in [4,5] of the explicit degree-61 polynomial P₅ in Equation (2.15) of the source.

counterexample.description: A rational \(5\times5\) matrix with growth factor exceeding the conjectured algebraic value \(4.1325\ldots\). Continuous optimization can propose candidates and exact arithmetic can certify them. The 1988 work found the numerical value; the degree-61-root maximum was first posed explicitly as a conjecture in 2026.
